citation: Rhodes CH, et al. Am J Clin Nutr 2023;117:286
protocol: Single 36-h water-only fast; blood at about 08:00 after 12 h overnight fast (baseline), 2 h after a fed meal, at 36 h fasting, and 2 h after refeeding
population: 20 young healthy adults, 20-40 y, BMI 19-27, men and women
note: Four metabolic states in the same people; glucose and total ketone bodies by NMR (umol/L); no insulin in the main text.
